Apple Pie for Two Oven Trays

Two-tray apple slab pie for your AEG Competence oven. Dough is mixed in your Kenwood Titanium Chef Patissier XL KWL90.244SI with the main mixing bowl and mixing insert, then both trays bake on fan/convection.

20-24 pieces, from two standard oven trays2 hr 10 minMedium

1AssumptionsWhat I decided for you — override anything here

  • Interpreted "two plates for my stove" as two flat oven trays/sheets.
  • Oven trays are roughly 30 x 40 cm each; if smaller, keep extra dough/filling aside or make the pie slightly thicker.
  • One cook is assumed.
  • AEG Competence exact model and program numbers are unconfirmed; use the fan/convection symbol for two-level baking.

2Required

Time

hands-on 0:55unattended 1:052 hr 10 min

Timeline

Checkpoints — all true before moving on

  • Oven-ready assembly · After dough is chilled and apple filling is mixedBoth trays are rolled, filled, covered, vented, egg-washed, and the AEG oven has reached 180 C fan/convection.
  • Halfway bake check · About 22 min into bakingIf the upper tray browns faster, swap tray positions and rotate each tray front to back.

Tools and parts

  • AEG Competence built-in electric ovenBake both apple pie trays at the same time on two shelf levels.
    Program ID not confirmed. Use Fan/Convection, 180 C, two levels, 35-45 min. Fallback: Top/bottom heat, 190 C, one tray at a time.
    Two oven trays/sheets lined with baking paper
  • Kenwood Titanium Chef Patissier XL KWL90.244SIRub butter into flour and bring the shortcrust dough together quickly without warming it by hand.
    Low speed for dry mix, then speed 1-2 only until dough clumps.
    Main bowl plus K-beater/paddle

Ingredients

  • plain wheat flour900 gFor shortcrust dough
  • cold unsalted butter450 gCut into 1-2 cm cubes
  • white sugar180 gFor dough
  • baking powder16 gAbout 4 tsp
  • fine salt8 gAbout 1 1/2 tsp
  • eggs4For dough
  • sour cream or thick yogurt200 gAdd just enough for dough to come together
  • apples2.4 kgFirm baking apples; weight before peeling/coring
  • brown or white sugar160 gFor filling; adjust to apple sweetness
  • lemon juice30 mlPrevents browning and balances sweetness
  • ground cinnamon12 gAbout 4 tsp
  • potato starch or corn starch50 gBinds apple juices
  • breadcrumbs or semolina80 gSprinkle under filling to absorb juice
  • egg1Beat for egg wash
  • coarse sugar30 gOptional topping

3Steps

  1. 1

    Prepare trays and cold ingredientsCook

    WorktopTwo oven trays, baking paper, rolling pinNo heat10 min

    2 oven trays, baking paper, cold butter, dry dough ingredients

    Line two oven trays with baking paper. Cube the cold butter and keep it cold while weighing the flour, dough sugar, baking powder, and salt.

    Both trays are lined and all dough ingredients are measured.

  2. 2

    Mix the shortcrust doughCook

    Kenwood Titanium Chef Patissier XL KWL90.244SIMain bowl plus K-beater/paddleLow speed until butter is pea-sizedspeed 1-2 after eggs and sour cream10-12 min

    Flour, butter, sugar, baking powder, salt, eggs, sour cream/yogurt

    Mix dry ingredients. Add butter until sandy. Add eggs and sour cream/yogurt. Stop as soon as dough clumps.

    Dough holds together when squeezed but still looks short and slightly crumbly.

  3. 3

    Divide and chill doughCook

    RefrigeratorWrap or covered containerCold storage30 min minimum

    Dough, wrap or covered container

    Divide dough into four portions: two slightly larger bottom pieces and two smaller top pieces. Flatten each into a rectangle, cover, and chill.

    Dough is firm enough to roll without smearing butter.

  4. 4

    Prepare apple fillingCook

    WorktopLarge bowl, knife or slicerNo heat25-30 min

    Apples, sugar, lemon juice, cinnamon, starch

    Peel/core apples. Slice 3-5 mm. Toss with sugar, lemon juice, cinnamon, and starch.

    Apples are evenly coated and starting to release a little juice.

  5. 5

    Preheat the AEG ovenCook

    AEG Competence built-in electric ovenTwo racks positioned in upper-middle and lower-middle levelsProgram ID not confirmeduse Fan/Convection, 180 C. Fallback: Top/bottom heat, 190 C, one tray at a time.15-20 min preheat

    AEG oven, two rack levels

    Preheat on fan/convection for two-level baking. If browning is uneven, use the fallback one-tray mode.

    Oven is fully preheated before trays go in.

  6. 6

    Assemble two traysCook

    WorktopTwo lined oven trays, rolling pinNo heat20-25 min

    Chilled dough, apple filling, breadcrumbs/semolina, egg wash

    Roll bases into trays. Add crumbs, apples, top dough, vents, egg wash, and optional coarse sugar.

    Both pies are sealed, vented, and ready to bake.

  7. 7

    Bake both traysCook

    AEG Competence built-in electric ovenTwo oven trays on two rack levelsFan/Convection 180 C, 35-45 min. Swap upper/lower trays and rotate front/back after 22 min if browning differs.35-45 min

    Two assembled trays

    Bake both trays. Swap upper/lower and rotate front/back after 22 min if browning differs.

    Pastry is golden underneath at the edges and filling bubbles visibly through vents.

  8. 8

    Cool and sliceCook

    Cooling rack or heatproof counterKnife, spatulaRoom temperature30 min minimum

    Cooling space, knife, spatula

    Cool before slicing. Cut each tray into 10-12 pieces.

    Pieces lift cleanly and the filling does not run.

  • Use clean hands and boards after handling raw egg.
  • Cool pies at room temperature, then refrigerate leftovers if keeping longer than the same day.
  • Reheat slices until hot throughout if serving later.

Apple Pie for Two Oven Trays

Apple Pie for Two Oven Trays

Two-tray apple slab pie for your AEG Competence oven. Dough is mixed in your Kenwood Titanium Chef Patissier XL KWL90.244SI with the main mixing bowl and mixing insert, then both trays bake on fan/convection.

Recipe Overview

Servings: 20-24 pieces, from two standard oven trays
Total Time: 2 hr 10 min
Hands-on: 55-65 min
Unattended: 65-75 min chilling and baking
Difficulty: Medium

1. Assumptions

What was assumed for this recipe. Override anything here:

  • Interpreted "two plates for my stove" as two flat oven trays/sheets.
  • Oven trays are roughly 30 x 40 cm each; if smaller, keep extra dough/filling aside or make the pie slightly thicker.
  • One cook is assumed.
  • AEG Competence exact model and program numbers are unconfirmed; use the fan/convection symbol for two-level baking.

Required Tools & Parts

AEG Competence built-in electric oven
Bake both apple pie trays at the same time on two shelf levels.
Program ID not confirmed. Use Fan/Convection, 180 C, two levels, 35-45 min. Fallback: Top/bottom heat, 190 C, one tray at a time.
Kenwood Titanium Chef Patissier XL KWL90.244SI
Rub butter into flour and bring the shortcrust dough together quickly without warming it by hand.
Low speed for dry mix, then speed 1-2 only until dough clumps.
